What changed in this PR Migrates shared validation and mobile profile forms to Zod 4, superseding the dependency-only update in #326 while preserving English and Portuguese error catalogs. **Changes:** - Adds a Zod 4-compatible localized error map and updates schema error callbacks. - Upgrades form dependencies, separates profile input/output types, and aligns preference validation with control values. - Pins workspace-wide Zod versions, adds migration tests, and documents breaking changes. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | pnpm-workspace.yaml | Overrides all Zod dependencies to 4.6.6. | | pnpm-lock.yaml | Records Zod and form dependency upgrades. | | packages/​shared/​schemas/​dog-schema.ts | Migrates error callbacks and exports profile input types. | | packages/​shared/​package.json | Updates shared Zod dependency. | | packages/​shared/​i18n/​zod-error.ts | Maps Zod 4 issues to existing translation catalogs. | | packages/​shared/​i18n/​i18n.ts | Registers the new localized error map. | | packages/​database/​package.json | Updates database Zod dependency. | | packages/​api/​src/​shared/​zod-migration.test.ts | Adds localization, resolver, transform, and collection-limit tests. | | packages/​api/​package.json | Updates API Zod dependency. | | CHANGELOG.md | Documents breaking changes and caller migration. | | apps/​mobile/​src/​views/​Preferences/​index.tsx | Aligns validation with preference controls and removes resolver casting. | | apps/​mobile/​src/​views/​EditProfile/​index.tsx | Separates raw form inputs from parsed outputs. | | apps/​mobile/​package.json | Upgrades Zod, React Hook Form, and resolvers. |

### 🔵 Needs a closer look The migration tests accept default English messages in Portuguese cases, allowing a regression that stops localizing generic errors to pass undetected. **No open issues** 🎉
1 previously missed issue In code that hasn't changed since last review
Assert Portuguese messages in localization migration tests `packages/​api/​src/​shared/​zod-migration.test.ts:87` These assertions also accept Zod's default English messages in the Portuguese case. For example, returning `undefined` for every non-custom issue in `localizedZodError` would leave this test passing even though generic errors were no longer localized. Please assert the expected locale-specific messages for these cases so the migration tests detect that regression.
